verdict.rationale: Rive documents extensive programmatic/text-based control—RML for building files as code, an MCP server exposing tools to create View Models, State Machines, Layouts, Shapes, data binding, and script editing, plus a CLI for agent-driven generation—suggesting much UI functionality is reachable via non-UI interfaces. However there's no public REST/OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), and MCP tooling is scoped to the desktop editor rather than a full headless API, so parity with every UI capability isn't demonstrated. missing for 10: a documented complete API/OpenAPI surface covering all editor features, independent confirmation that every UI action (e.g., visual curve editing, asset import) is scriptable outside the desktop app.
